# AgentEvent

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened during agent processing.

## Scope note

Events originated or performed by an AI agent (e.g. Claude-driven actions in the PKM system), as distinct from UserEvent (human) and ToolEvent/ServiceEvent (system).

## Broader

- [ToolEvent](../ToolEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
